title: Disappointing
text: Disappointing. I haven't burned candles in a long time, but I always bought Yankee. This one smells divine in the jar. I burned it for an hour yesterday and it burns fairly cleanly, but when burning I really didn't smell the scent much. Kind of disappointing for a candle that costs 30.00.
